text.en: OK to use. CoinGecko and the factory both confirm this vault. To review holds the adapter and oracles that only the Morpho API lists, which AI checked on chain.
text.zh-TW: 可以用。CoinGecko 和工廠都確認這個 vault；待確認是只有 Morpho API 列出的轉接合約和 oracle，AI 在鏈上查過。

text.en: This vault holds about 98 million USDC. 738 addresses hold shares; the largest has 11.51% and the top 10 hold 46.65%. Before 2026-02 it held only about 100,000 USDC; after that it stayed between 60 million and 124 million for the rest of the year.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 約 9,800 萬 USDC，738 個地址持有股份，最大一個占 11.51%，前 10 名占 46.65%。2026-02 前只有約 10 萬 USDC，之後一年都在 6,000 萬到 1.24 億之間。

recommendation.en: It is large, so raising a cap puts many depositors' funds into this market. Set the cap by your risk framework.
recommendation.zh-TW: 規模大，提高上限會讓很多存款人的錢進這個市場；上限照你的風險框架給。

text.en: This vault's timelock for both `increaseAbsoluteCap` and `increaseRelativeCap` is 7 days (`timelock` read on chain, 604800 seconds). For 7 days after it is sent, depositors can see this change, and the sentinel or curator can cancel it with `revoke`.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 的 `increaseAbsoluteCap` 和 `increaseRelativeCap` 的 timelock 都是 7 天（鏈上讀 `timelock`，604800 秒）：送出後 7 天內存款人看得到這個變更，sentinel 或 curator 可以用 `revoke` 取消。

recommendation.en: If you find a mistake within 7 days of sending, cancel it with `revoke`; do not wait for it to be executed.
recommendation.zh-TW: 送出後 7 天內發現填錯，用 `revoke` 取消，不要等它被執行。

text.en: The program's only check is the Morpho API: asked for this vault's adapters, it answers 0xDF62f57Ea333a842Db200d4892c90F98204fa22F, and only this one. AI also checked two things on chain: the vault's `isAdapter` answers true for this address and `adaptersLength` is 1; and running pnpm prove-instance, MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2Factory 0x32BB1c0D48D8b1B3363e86eeB9A0300BAd61ccc1 answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true, and both providers agree.
text.zh-TW: 程式只有 Morpho API 確認：問這個 vault 的 adapters，回答 0xDF62f57Ea333a842Db200d4892c90F98204fa22F，也只有這一個。AI 另外在鏈上確認兩件事：vault 的 `isAdapter` 對這個地址回答 true，`adaptersLength` 是 1；跑 pnpm prove-instance，MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2Factory 0x32BB1c0D48D8b1B3363e86eeB9A0300BAd61ccc1 回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，兩個節點一致。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. The cap id uses this very address; a wrong one would only set a cap on an id the vault does not use.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；上限的 id 用的就是這個地址，填錯只會設到一個 vault 不用的 id。

role.en: USDC vault (V2, USDC Prime) managed by Gauntlet; you are its curator
role.zh-TW: Gauntlet 管理的 USDC vault（V2，USDC Prime），你是它的 curator

text.en: Gauntlet's own API lists this address: Gauntlet USDC Prime v2, morpho_v2, curator 0x9E33faAE38ff641094fa68c65c2cE600b3410585, the same as `curator` read on chain
text.zh-TW: Gauntlet 自己的 API 列出這個地址：Gauntlet USDC Prime v2，morpho_v2，curator 0x9E33faAE38ff641094fa68c65c2cE600b3410585，跟鏈上 `curator` 讀到的一樣

role.en: The vault's Morpho Blue market adapter; the cap id uses its address
role.zh-TW: vault 的 Morpho Blue 市場轉接合約，上限的 id 用它的地址

role.en: The Morpho Vault V2 factory. It answers `isVaultV2` = true: it created this vault
role.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 工廠，它回答 `isVaultV2` = true，這個 vault 是它建立的
